title: From shopping
slide_intent: Establish the practical end of the type range with a familiar purchase. The ordinary object gives readers a concrete starting point for the following contrast.
strategic_value: Instacart can connect its typographic system to the routine act of buying a grocery item.
demonstration: A cream field carries the dark Sans phrase From shopping at lower left and a plastic milk jug tilted across the right.
practical_value: Use a direct sans-serif treatment when the communication emphasizes the item or the shopping task. Compare the next page to see how the same story changes after preparation.

content_islands.name: Shopping phrase
content_islands.spec: Place two large dark lines at lower left, with generous space above.

content_islands.name: Grocery object
content_islands.spec: Angle the milk jug into the right side of the pale canvas, retaining its cap and cast shadow.
